title: pmrepulsor_1d
description: `pmrepulsor_1d` is a control abstraction with a float output that accepts `bang`, `force`, `grab`, and `grab_on` messages, plus float inputs on its other two inlets. The help patch demonstrates setting `force` and `grab` values and toggling `grab_on`, but it does not explain the object’s purpose or the meaning of its outputs sufficiently.
